{{Otheruses|Chief Scientist}}
'''Chief Scientist''' was the title the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] held during her tenure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], working on the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was also held by [[Frexton]] when he worked at the [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] [[Corulag Academy|Academy]], though he lost the title when he kidnapped a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Teela Panjarra|baby girl]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Silas Tagge/Legends|Silas Tagge]] was the Chief Scientist of the House of Tagge.

[[Crimsol Vaighn]] was the chief scientist of the [[Mummers|Mummer]] terrorist group.<ref name="SWG:BTttT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring Terror to the Terrorists|Naboo}}</ref> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vigh]] was the chief scientist of the [[GeneTech Syndicate]].<ref name="GP">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66911&resource=features|text=Genetic Potential}}</ref> [[K'ar Zah]] was the chief scientist of the [[Imperial Academy of Science and Methodology]].<ref name="SWG:SCoS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Serve Cause of Science}}</ref>
